units.text: The “normal” ⟦0⟧ output format shows each hunk of differences without any surrounding context. Sometimes such output is the clearest way to see how lines have changed, without the clutter of nearby unchanged lines (although you can get similar results with the context or unified formats by using 0 lines of context). However, this format is no longer widely used for sending out patches; for that purpose, the context format (see ⟦1⟧Context Format⟦2⟧) and the unified format (see ⟦3⟧Unified Format⟦4⟧) are superior. Normal format is the default for compatibility with older versions of ⟦5⟧ and the POSIX standard. Use the ⟦6⟧ option to select this output format explicitly.

Normal format is the default for compatibility with older versions of diff and the POSIX standard. Use the --normal option to select this output format explicitly.
